added.summary: A dot role part with data-tone (success, danger, warn, info, primary) now fills with that tone. The overlay layout primitive now stacks its other children as a column, so a scroller inside it is bounded while a fade or badge is anchored over it.

fixed.summary: The window edge mask is now data-fade-ends (x or y); as data-edge it collided with a sheet's dock edge and was refused.
